subsystem.name: UIPlatformAndOptions
subsystem.responsibility: UI platform layer and options/menu plumbing: file-path construction with callback invocation, scene-list rebuild from global state, session screen routing, a family of UI component/options constructors, menu list widgets (item creation, indexed access, search/select, text set), a tile-grid layout engine, and a collision-region builder shared with the rendering dispatch.

summary: DERIVED architecture proposal for the ui_platform_and_options scope. The packet covers twenty-two functions grouped into five layers. (1) File/scene path layer: PlatformPathServices (0x0040DC00) builds a file path from a config/track base (dword_7CE5D0, falling back to byte_5EA438), strips any existing extension, appends a separator plus extension, and invokes an out-callback; SceneListBuilder (0x0046A2A0) clears and rebuilds the scene linked list from the global scene array (dword_8AC490 / count dword_8AC488), trimming each name to its final backslash component before load. (2) Session routing layer: SessionScreenRouter (0x0046FC30) routes the post-session state to a championship, multiplayer host/client grid, or main-menu screen based on the race-mode global dword_7D0410. (3) Constructor family: UIComponentBase groups the shared component-constructor layout (base init 0x00466D60, vtable install, data-source pointer at this+0x31C, value-count/current/range state block at this+0x324..0x330, component id at this+0x334) seen in 0x004711A0, 0x00471540, 0x004718E0, 0x00471970 and 0x004726C0; UIOptionsScreen (0x00476030) derives from the base UI object constructor 0x0048FC50; UIStyleControlBase (0x00485E30) is a shared seventeen-constructor initializer with zeroed general fields and five sentinel-guarded range pairs; UIBaseControlStruct (0x0048E9E0) initializes a base control struct with a vtable and -1 sentinel. (4) Menu/list widget layer: UIMenuListController groups the list widget operations (item creation 0x00489600, indexed item fetch 0x00489A10, search by name 0x00489A50, search-and-select 0x00489BA0, item text set 0x00489C10, filtered rebuild 0x0048A3C0) over a node list with next-link at node+0x8C and label at node+0xB0 (UIMenuItemNode); UIStringPropertyControl (0x00488B40) compares and replaces a stored string; UIMenuLayoutViewport (0x0047B850) computes the active menu item from margins, item height and scroll offset; SeasonResultsMenuBuilder (0x0047D800) descends the season data tree and creates paired driver/time menu items. (5) Layout/collision layer: UITileGrid (0x0048F870) computes and places tile screen positions from a cell/spacing grid; CollisionRegionBuilder (0x00491960) validates positive dimensions and forwards them to two collision-broadphase builder slots. Owner is UNKNOWN for most functions; UITileGrid and SessionScreenRouter owners are DERIVED from the packet. Class grouping is a GUESS-level interpretation of shared constructor patterns and linked-list layouts; equal byte offsets on different 'this' bases are kept as separate fields.

function_roles.role: Builds a file path string and invokes an out-callback with it. Selects the base path dword_7CE5D0 (falling back to byte_5EA438), concatenates it with the extension string off_5BEB4C into a heap buffer, truncates at the last '.' to strip an existing extension, appends the separator word_5BEB48 and extension off_5BEB4C, calls the callback 0x0040DBE0, frees the buffer, and returns the callback result (0 on allocation failure). Invoked by Steward_Restart (0x004D3CF0) as part of a track/configuration file path.

Clears and rebuilds the scene linked list from the global scene array: LinkedListDestructionWithVTableCall (0x0048D230) clears the old list, the loop reads the count from dword_8AC488 and iterates the array at dword_8AC490 (stride 396, name at entry+4), trims each name to the last backslash component, formats the filename via the format table off_5C6660, loads the scene object through 0x00497AD0 (falling back to off_5C665C), and appends the node with 0x0048D2B0.

Routes the post-session state to a UI screen based on the race-mode global dword_7D0410. Optionally stops the sound engine (dword_5EB10C vtable slot +12) and resets the buffer flt_5EA618; mode 4 (championship) calls 0x004A0760 then opens the post-race driver screen aChPostracedriv via GuardedFunctionDispatch (0x00486AA0); mode 5 (multiplayer) uses StateCheckWrapper (0x00461DC0) on dword_7CD25C to open the host grid aMphostgrid or client grid aMpclientgrid via LookupDispatch (0x00497940) on dword_7CD8C0; otherwise opens the main menu aMainMenu and sets the session-init global dword_5CC9E8 to 3.

UI-mode object constructor: runs the base initializer 0x00466D60 with flag 1, installs the vtable off_5A0B40 at this+0x0, stores the address of dword_7D0A20 into this+0x31C, and writes the literal fields 99/2/1/1 at this+0x324/+0x328/+0x32C/+0x330. No guards; returns this.

UI component constructor (component ID 236): base init 0x00466D60 with 1, vtable off_5A0E40 at this+0x0, data-source interface dword_7CE73C bound at this+0x31C, state block this+0x324=2/+0x328=0/+0x32C=1/+0x330=1, component id 236 at this+0x334, then inserts the three handle globals off_5BE704/off_5C32A4/aHigh (0x005C32A8) via 0x00486F30 with index -1 and dispatches the post-construction virtual 0x004670E0.

UI component constructor (component ID 243): identical sequence to 0x00471540 with vtable off_5A1380, data source dword_7CE760 at this+0x31C, state block 2/0/1/1, component id 243 at this+0x334, the same three handles inserted with index -1, and post-construction dispatch 0x004670E0.

UI component constructor (component ID 244): identical sequence to 0x00471540 with vtable off_5A1440, data source dword_7CE7F0 at this+0x31C, state block 2/0/1/1, component id 244 at this+0x334, the same three handles inserted with index -1, and post-construction dispatch 0x004670E0.

UI options component constructor: base init 0x00466D60 with 1, vtable off_5A2040 at this+0x0, data-source interface dword_7CFF84 at this+0x31C, option count 3 at this+0x324, initial/current value 1 at this+0x328, boundary fields 1 at this+0x32C and this+0x330, component identifier 259 at this+0x334, and default-selection sentinel -1 at this+0x338.

Options-screen UI object constructor: calls the base UI object constructor 0x0048FC50 unconditionally, installs the options vtable off_5A4428 at this+0x0, zeroes the state/flag field at this+0x3C, and returns the object.

Menu item layout calculator: reads the item height at this+0xF4 (returns 0 if not positive), derives the usable width from the width argument minus margins this+0xF8/this+0xC, maps the height into a clamped line index over this+0xF0-1, then walks wrapped items from the scroll offset this+0xEC via MenuCursorNavigationHelper (0x0047B730) until the queried index is found, resolves a resource-path string through this+0xC8 (falling back to byte_5EA438, processed by 0x00498560), and renders through MenuItemRenderHelper (0x0047B910).

Season results/leaderboard menu builder: resets UI state (StateCleanupNotification 0x00489CB0), locates the season races section with 0x004C5840 rooted at unk_8AC368, descends the prevyear/grid/drivers+times keys with StringKeyedLinkedListSearch (0x005679C0), and when the driver and time list counts match (LinkedListCount 0x00567980) iterates both, pairs each driver name with its time via the byte_5EA438 separator using the format string at 0x005C6784, and creates one UI menu item per pair with UIMenuItemCreator (0x00489600).

Shared UI-style component initializer used by seventeen UI-family constructors (0x0047A9E0, 0x00487220, 0x00487660, 0x00487ED0, 0x00488180, 0x00488B00, 0x00488F90, 0x004893C0, 0x0048B420, 0x0048D3A0, 0x0048E070, 0x0048E600, 0x0048EAA0, 0x0048FB70, 0x0048FE60, 0x00490250, 0x00493FC0): runs the base initializer 0x0049A930, zeros the general fields this+0x44..0x60 and this+0x70..0x7C, initializes five (min=0, max=-1) sentinel range pairs at this+0xA0/0xA4 .. 0xC0/0xC4, installs the vtable off_5AB8C0, and runs the final setup 0x00486010.

UI string compare-and-set: returns -1 when a2 is null; otherwise compares a2 against the stored string at this+0xB0 (falling back to byte_5EA438) and, when they differ, copies the new string via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650) and invokes the vtable slot at obj offset 0x2C with argument 1 to notify/reload. Returns 0 on the equal or updated path.

UI menu item creator: early-exits with -1 when the label a2 is null, allocates a 232-byte item block, initializes its vtable via 0x00488F90, copies the label and up to three further strings (fallback from a3, then this+0xB8, then byte_5EA438) with StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650), registers the item into the list controller with 0x00486340, pops a list entry with 0x00489480, dispatches the controller vtable slots at obj offsets 0x2C and 0xAC, and returns 0.

Linked-list item lookup by index (UI_List_Item_by_Index): returns null when a2 is negative or the head at this+0x90 is null, walks the next-node links at node+0x8C for a2 steps, returns the string at node+0xB0 of the target node (byte_5EA438 when null). Sole caller is 0x0046BA20.

Linked-list search by name: returns 0 when a2 or the head at this+0x90 is null; walks nodes comparing each node string (node+176, byte_5EA438 when null) against a2 via 0x00588410, writes the match index to *a3 when found and returns 1, otherwise 0.

Linked-list search and select: walks the node list from this+0x90 comparing each label (node+0xB0, byte_5EA438 when null) against a2 via 0x00588410 and, on a match, calls UIListSelectionHandler (0x00489AB0) with this, the index and a3. Returns -1 on null inputs, a miss, or list exhaustion; 0 on a successful selection.

UI list item text setter: bounds-checks the index against the count at this+0x94 (returns 0 out of range), walks the list head this+0x90 to the node at the index, then copies the caller string (byte_5EA438 when null) into the node text buffer via 0x00566650 and returns 1.

Filtered linked-list rebuild: saves the selection index this+0x168 and count this+0x94, obtains reference text via 0x00489970/0x00489920, walks every item, compares each item's text against byte_5EA438 by the filter mode a2 (length or lexicographic via 0x00587ECE/0x00588410, switch table 0x0048A634), copies matches into a new node list via 0x00486400, tracks the new index of the previously selected item, installs the new list head at this+0x90 with the original count restored when the old head was null, and selects the tracked item with 0x00489AB0.

Base UI control struct initializer: installs the vtable off_5A443C at this+0x0, sets the -1 sentinel at this+0x8, zeroes this+0x4 and this+0xC..0x28, copies the default directory string byte_5EA438 via 0x00566650, and returns this.

Tile-grid layout engine (UITileGrid): reads two values through DualFieldRead (0x00498880), computes the column count that fits between this+0x120 and this+0x124 using cell width plus spacing (this+0x160 + this+0x150), clamps to this+0xFC, walks rows (this+0x158) and columns (this+0x15C), finds the tile node per linear index from the list seed this+0xF0 through each node's +4 next pointer (tile object at node+0), computes tile X from this+0x120 and column step (center/right alignment per this+0xE0, offset from this+0x168) and tile Y from this+0x140 and row step, places each tile with 0x0048EA20, then invokes the vtable slot at obj offset 44 with argument 1. Callers: 0x0048F1A0, 0x0048F640, 0x0048FAF0, 0x0048FB30.

Collision-region builder dispatch with dimension guard: rejects the call when a4 or a5 is not positive (returns 0), otherwise forwards a2/a3/a4/a5 to CollisionBroadphaseBuilder (0x00490EE0) twice, first with the builder pointer at this[0]+28 and then at this[0]+44, returning 1.

classes.name: PlatformPathServices
classes.responsibility: Builds a file path from a config/track base plus an extension, strips any prior extension, and hands the result to an out-callback for further processing.

classes.name: SceneListBuilder
classes.responsibility: Clears and rebuilds the global scene linked list from the scene array, trimming each scene name to its final path component before loading the scene object.

classes.name: SessionScreenRouter
classes.responsibility: Routes the post-session state to a championship, multiplayer host/client grid, or main-menu screen based on the race-mode global, with an optional sound-engine stop and buffer reset first.

classes.name: UIComponentBase
classes.responsibility: Shared UI component constructor pattern: base initializer, vtable install, data-source interface bound at this+0x31C, a value-count/current/range state block at this+0x324..0x330, and a component id at this+0x334 (optionally a default-selection sentinel at this+0x338).

classes.name: UIOptionsScreen
classes.responsibility: Options-screen UI object: derives from the base UI object constructor and installs the options vtable, with a state/flag field cleared at init.

classes.name: UIMenuLayoutViewport
classes.responsibility: Computes the active menu item from the layout geometry (margins, item height, scroll offset, visible-item ceiling) and drives wrap navigation and rendering.

classes.name: SeasonResultsMenuBuilder
classes.responsibility: Descends the season data tree (prevyear/grid/drivers+times) and creates one UI menu item per paired driver/time entry.

classes.name: UIStyleControlBase
classes.responsibility: Shared initializer for seventeen UI-family constructors: zeros the general-purpose fields, initializes five sentinel-guarded (min=0, max=-1) range pairs, installs a vtable and runs a final setup subroutine.

classes.name: UIStringPropertyControl
classes.responsibility: A UI control holding one string that is compared against a caller-supplied value and replaced (with a vtable notification) when it differs.

classes.name: UIMenuListController
classes.responsibility: Owns a linked list of menu item nodes (head at this+0x90, count at this+0x94, selection at this+0x168) and provides item creation, indexed fetch, search, select, text-set and filtered-rebuild operations over the node list.

classes.name: UIMenuItemNode
classes.responsibility: A linked-list node of a menu list: holds the next-node link and the label string used by indexed fetch, search, and text-set operations.

classes.name: UIBaseControlStruct
classes.responsibility: Base control struct initialization: vtable install, -1 sentinel, zeroed rectangle-like field block, and a copied default directory string.

classes.name: UITileGrid
classes.responsibility: Computes and places screen positions for tiles in a grid layout from grid bounds, cell width/spacing, row and column counts, alignment mode and offset fields, then invokes a completion vtable slot.

classes.name: CollisionRegionBuilder
classes.responsibility: Validates positive region dimensions and forwards the coordinates to two collision-broadphase builder slots reachable through this[0].

transitions.event: dword_7D0410 equals 5 and the state check on dword_7CD25C selects host
dword_7D0410 equals 5 and the state check on dword_7CD25C selects client
dword_7D0410 is neither 4 nor 5; the session-init global dword_5CC9E8 is set to 3

interfaces.name: DataSourceBinding
interfaces.purpose: A per-component data-source interface pointer bound at this+0x31C by the UI component constructors; each component id receives a distinct data source object.

interfaces.name: ScreenOpenDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Opens a named UI screen by string lookup through GuardedFunctionDispatch (0x00486AA0) and LookupDispatch (0x00497940), driven by the session router.

interfaces.name: PathBuilderCallback
interfaces.purpose: Receives a fully constructed file path string from PlatformPathServices and performs the caller-specific handling; the callback identity is not established by the packet.

compatibility_contracts.name: UIComponentStateBlockLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Any replacement UI component constructor must preserve the field layout at this+0x31C (data-source pointer), this+0x324 (value count), this+0x328 (current value), this+0x32C/0x330 (range bounds), this+0x334 (component id) and this+0x338 (optional default-selection sentinel) so that other UI subsystems reading these offsets keep working.

compatibility_contracts.name: MenuListNodeLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Menu list nodes must expose the next-link at node+0x8C and the label string at node+0xB0, with the controller head at this+0x90 and the item count at this+0x94; indexed fetch, search, select and text-set all rely on this layout.

compatibility_contracts.name: DefaultStringFallback
compatibility_contracts.description: UI subsystem functions fall back to the global byte_5EA438 string whenever a stored path/label pointer is null (path base, menu label default, list item fallback, separator source); the replacement must keep supplying a valid default string at this global.

compatibility_contracts.name: ScenePathTrimBeforeLoad
compatibility_contracts.description: Scene list rebuild assumes scene names are file paths and trims each to the final backslash component before formatting and loading the scene object.
